title: Lender provides £4.5m for London buy-to-let properties
summary:
Butterfield Mortgages Limited has completed a £4.5 million financing deal for the acquisition of two central London buy-to-let properties valued at £7 million. The transaction was structured through a holding company and two special purpose vehicles at 65% loan-to-value.

title: Shawbrook backs £7.5m Essex development with planning changes
summary:
Shawbrook has completed a £7.5m development finance facility for a ten-unit residential scheme in Shenfield, Essex, which secured planning enhancements during construction that increased its scope and value. The Birley Grange development carried a gross development value of approximately £11.5m.

title: Mixed-use Hertfordshire site secures £1.25m finance
summary:
A 50-acre mixed-use site near Hitchin, Hertfordshire, has been acquired for £1.8 million with a £1.25 million acquisition facility from MERA. The former commercial glasshouse site includes two bungalows, five acres of glasshouses, and approximately 40 acres of farmland.

title: Your Move acquires 250-property lettings portfolio
summary:
Your Move Williams Rose has acquired a 250-property landlord portfolio from Assured Property Rentals in Keynsham. The transaction marks the seventh franchise partner acquisition supported by LSL Estate Agency Franchising this year.

title: Lomond appoints new CEO as portfolio reaches 70,000 properties
summary:
Estate and lettings agency group Lomond has appointed Paul Geddes as Group Chief Executive as the company targets further expansion. The group now manages over 70,000 properties, up from 34,000 in 2022.

title: Lettings portfolios drive estate agency valuations
summary:
Lettings operations have emerged as the primary value driver for estate agencies, as recurring income models attract increased interest from investors and corporate consolidators. The shift reflects a fundamental change in how property businesses are valued, with lettings portfolios now often representing the most significant asset on an agency's balance sheet.

title: UK housing market enters critical period as rates rise
summary:
The UK housing market faces a critical period as the Bank of England's interest rate decisions and the Autumn Budget approach. Major lenders including HSBC and NatWest have already raised mortgage rates amid swap market volatility.

title: Derelict properties fetch average £240,000 in South East
summary:
Derelict properties in the South East are attracting average asking prices of £237,500, according to new data from property portal LandSale. The typical asking price for a derelict property across Britain stands at £122,500, with an average plot size of 6.26 acres.

title: Eviction disputes rise as landlords exit rental market
summary:
Eviction disputes are increasing across the rental sector, with landlords facing mounting costs and delays as tenants challenge possession proceedings. Law firm Thackray Williams reports a sharp rise in instructions from landlords seeking vacant possession following the introduction of the Renters' Rights Act.

title: UK house prices fall 0.4% in first annual decline since 2023
summary:
UK house prices have recorded their first annual decline in almost three years, falling 0.4% year-on-year in August as higher mortgage rates and affordability constraints weigh on the market. The average property cost £298,468, with London and the south-east experiencing the steepest falls.
